description:
Load the Natural Earth countries shapefile into gvSIG Desktop as a new vector layer.

gvSIG Desktop is already open with an empty View window. The Table of Contents panel on the left is empty (no layers loaded). Your task:

1. Add the countries shapefile as a vector layer. Right-click in the empty Table of Contents (left panel) to open the context menu, then select 'Add layer'. Alternatively, use the Layer menu in the menu bar (Layer > Add Layer > Add Vector Layer) if it is active.
2. In the 'Add layer' staging dialog that appears, click the 'Add' button to open the file browser.
3. In the file browser, type the full path /home/ga/gvsig_data/countries/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp in the File Name field (or navigate to that folder), then click 'Open'.
4. Back in the 'Add layer' staging dialog, click 'OK' to confirm.
5. The countries layer will now appear in the Table of Contents and the world map will be visible in the View canvas as solid-colored polygons (gvSIG displays the entire layer in a single color).

The task is complete when the ne_110m_admin_0_countries layer is loaded and the world map is visible in the gvSIG View window.
